scope: all blobs reachable from every ref (git rev-list --objects --all), every commit and annotated-tag message, and tracked plus untracked-unignored working-tree files

rules.description: NEAR ed25519 secret key: `ed25519:` and base58 decoding to 64 bytes (public keys are 32 bytes and ignored)
NEAR secp256k1 secret key: `secp256k1:` and base58 decoding to 32 bytes (public keys are 64 bytes and ignored)
seed or recovery phrase: a seed_phrase/mnemonic/recovery phrase field holding 12 to 24 lowercase words
GitHub token (classic, fine-grained, OAuth, app or refresh)
OpenAI-style `sk-` key, also used by OpenAI-compatible providers such as NEAR AI Cloud
value assigned to a key, token, secret or password name (generic; triaged by hand)
private key or credential file name (id_rsa, id_ed25519, *.pem, *.p12, *.key, .near-credentials/)
